name: xiaomi_getapps_ads-mcp
display_name: 小米营销 Xiaomi Ads MCP
description: 小米营销 Xiaomi Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, update_budget. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_xiaomi_getapps_ads_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOMI_GETAPPS_ADS_APP_ID
platform_mcp_xiaomi_getapps_ads_app_id.description: appId of the external application your Xiaomi account manager (AM) created when Marketing API access was approved ('申请通过后，AM提供appId、appKey等应用信息').

platform_mcp_xiaomi_getapps_ads_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOMI_GETAPPS_ADS_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_xiaomi_getapps_ads_app_key.description: appKey of that application; exchanged for an access token with POST /foreign/token/createToken.

tools.name: me
tools.description: 2.4 获取国家列表 (GET /foreign/marketing/region/countryList, no parameters) returns {code, result:[{geoType, id, name}]} for a valid token, so it verifies the app credentials without an account id. The earlier probe (campaign/list with page/pageSize only) is refused before authentication with code 100500 "Required List parameter 'accountIds' is not present" (auth audit 2026-09-26).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: 1.1 获取广告计划 (GET /foreign/marketing/campaign/list with page, pageSize, accountIds): records {accountId, campaignId, name, dayBudget (美元×100000, left in raw), campaignType (1 应用下载, 2 H5, 3 再营销)}; result.total/pages give the paging. account_id is sent as accountIds. No status or dates are returned.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: The API has no campaign update call; budgets are edited on 广告组 (ad groups) with 2.3 修改广告组 (POST /foreign/marketing/group/update {groupIds, dayBudget}), so campaign_id here is a groupId (from 2.1 获取广告组, GET /foreign/marketing/group/list). daily_budget is in US dollars and sent as dayBudget in 美元×100000. This spends money; currency is ignored (USD).
